Verdict: needs_changes.

FINDING (high, architecture): AC2e is not met because status derivation is still per-provider ad hoc, not a single shared helper applied uniformly. Evidence: `config_inventory.py` has direct `status=Status...` branches across providers and no shared status derivation helper; `rg` only found `_probe_loadable`/`_safe`, not a status helper. Recommendation: introduce one shared derivation helper that maps validated provider facts to status and route every provider through it.

FINDING (high, correctness): stale project/onboarding state can report `ok`. Evidence: `provider_projects_registry` uses only `len(reg.projects)` for status; a fake registry entry pointing at `/definitely/missing/dontpanic-project` returned `ok 1 project(s) registered`. Recommendation: validate registered project paths/onboarding state and report non-ok when entries are stale/unrunnable.

FINDING (high, test_coverage): the exhaustive invariant test does not cover AC2e’s minimum invalid-manifest or stale-onboarding cases. Evidence: `_NON_OPTIMISTIC_CASES` has `agent_manifest_absent` and `install_reconcile_no_snapshot`, but no invalid manifest and no stale onboarding/registry case. Recommendation: add real malformed `agent-manifest.json` and stale registered project/onboarding fixtures to the single parametrized invariant test.

FINDING (medium, correctness): ready capabilities are miscounted as zero ready. Evidence: `provider_capabilities` ch
